Kit summary

Dartling ShooterBasicExclusive Lv.2
Deals 3 stages of 200% DEF DMG each to a single enemy and each stage transfers 1 layer of a debuff from self to the target.
Shark Anchor Gun Lv.2Each time when Dartling Shooter transfers 1 layer of a debuff successfully or Violent Implication is triggered, Johnny will gain 1 layer of [Heavy Anchor] for 3 turns (up to 4 layers can be owned). Each layer of [Heavy Anchor] increases DEF by 8% and Effect RES by 8%.
Valiant MercenaryPassive
At the beginning of each wave, Johnny grants [Master] (cannot be removed when the owner dies) on the ally with the highest ATK. When the ally with [Master] is inflicted with debuffs by enemies for the first 3 times each turn, there is a 100% chance to make Johnny the main target instead. The chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.
Violent ImplicationPassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
When Johnny is inflicted with a debuff, there is a 25% chance to be immune to it. Restores self HP by 5% of Max HP and gains 1 layer of [Loaded Cannon] (up to 4 layers can be owned) when the effect is triggered. The chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.
Shark Anchor Gun Lv.2Each time when Dartling Shooter transfers 1 layer of a debuff successfully or Violent Implication is triggered, Johnny will gain 1 layer of [Heavy Anchor] for 3 turns (up to 4 layers can be owned). Each layer of [Heavy Anchor] increases DEF by 8% and Effect RES by 8%.
Shark Anchor Gun Lv.3Johnny has a 50% chance to be immune to control effects. When Violent Implication is triggered, grants all allies [Effect RES Up Ⅱ] for 2 turns.
Spiral CannonActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 2 stages of 140% DEF DMG each to all enemies. For every 1 layer of [Loaded Cannon] owned by Johnny, the second stage deals extra 50% DEF DMG. Afterward, removes all layers of [Loaded Cannon] owned by Johnny.
Shark Anchor Gun Lv.1Johnny also gains 1 layer of [Loaded Cannon] when gaining a buff, up to 8 layers of [Loaded Cannon] can be owned.
